> The method was checking if the component was collapsed or not
> before triggering the render

Some websites are using collapsing widgets to be able to have a lot of widgets without messing up the display. Thus always rendering widgets was not efficient since a lot of them were collapsed.

> As we now always need to update the
> render of the header, being collapsed or not

We only need to update it when the active count has changed right? We should find a way to not render the widget if no values were updated. Unsure that's doable.
